report:
Final settings: batch_size 4, workers 14, prefetch 0. Final throughput: 700.0 req/s at p99 199.0 ms (within the 200 ms hard limit).

Start: batch_size 8, workers 1, prefetch 0 gave 100.0 req/s at p99 197.2 ms.
Method: searched every integer setting (batch_size 1-9, workers 1-29, prefetch 0-39) with bench.py's measure() and kept only settings with p99 <= 200 ms, as SPEC.md makes that a hard limit. The highest throughput among them is the setting above. It was then confirmed by running python bench.py on the new config.json.
No setting above 700.0 req/s keeps p99 at or under 200 ms.
